name: otterscript-vscode
description: OtterScript language support: syntax highlighting, IntelliSense (hover, completion, signature help), diagnostics with quick fixes, navigation, and snippets.

otterscript.signatureHelp.enable.description: Enable signature help for functions and operations

otterscript.hover.enable.description: Enable hover information for functions and operations

otterscript.codeLens.enable.description: Enable CodeLens reference counts above module declarations

otterscript.workspaceSymbols.enable.description: List the modules declared in .otter/.oscript files in 'Go to Symbol in Workspace' (Ctrl+T). Cross-file Go to Definition, Rename and Find References work either way.

otterscript.inlayHints.parameterNames.markdownDescription: Show parameter names before the positional arguments of a function call, such as `$Substring($x, Offset: 2, Length: 3)`. Functions with one parameter and arguments that are already a variable of that name get none. VS Code's `#editor.inlayHints.enabled#` setting also hides or shows all inlay hints.

enumDescriptions: Leave out what only Otter or only BuildMaster has (ProGet runs the core execution engine both share), keeping ProGet's notifier variables.
Leave out what only BuildMaster or only ProGet has.
Leave out what only Otter or only ProGet has.
otterscript.product.markdownDescription: The Inedo product your scripts run in. Completion then leaves out the functions, variables and operations that product doesn't have, based on Inedo's Otter and BuildMaster reference. Hover notes when a function, variable or operation isn't in that product, and signature help and parameter-name hints use the product's form of a function whose arguments differ between products; diagnostics are not affected.

otterscript.diagnostics.rules.markdownDescription: Turn off individual OtterScript diagnostics, or change how severe they are, by diagnostic code (shown in the Problems panel). Set a code to `"off"` to hide it, or to `"error"`, `"warning"`, `"information"` or `"hint"` to change its severity. Codes not listed keep their default.

missing-dollar.markdownDescription: A variable in a condition is missing its `$` sigil.

assignment-in-condition.markdownDescription: `=` used in a condition where `==` was probably meant.

invalid-operator.markdownDescription: A single `&` or `|` used where `&&` or `||` is required.

incorrect-for-usage.markdownDescription: `for` used as a loop (OtterScript loops use `foreach`).

duplicate-module.markdownDescription: A `module` whose name another module in the same file already has.

duplicate-map-key.markdownDescription: The same key appears twice in a `%(...)` map expression.

unknown-scalar-function.markdownDescription: A `$Name(...)` call to a function this extension doesn't know.

unknown-vector-function.markdownDescription: An `@Name(...)` call to a function this extension doesn't know.

unknown-operation.markdownDescription: An operation call this extension doesn't know.

unknown-namespace.markdownDescription: An unknown `Namespace::` qualifier on an operation.

too-many-arguments.markdownDescription: A function call with more arguments than the function accepts.

missing-required-argument.markdownDescription: An operation call without one of its required arguments, such as `Copy-Files` without `To`. A hint by default: an operation may accept argument names Inedo's reference doesn't list.

unknown-argument.markdownDescription: An operation argument name that looks like a typo of a documented one, such as `Fomr:` in `Copy-Files`. A hint by default: an operation may accept argument names Inedo's reference doesn't list.

unknown-with-directive.markdownDescription: A `with` block directive that isn't one of `retry`, `timeout`, `executionPolicy`, `async`, `lock`, `isolation` or `credentials`, such as `retyr=3`.

invalid-with-directive-value.markdownDescription: A `with` block directive's value it doesn't take, such as `executionPolicy=sometimes` or `retry=many`, a missing one (`retry` alone), or a value on `isolation`, which takes none.

unknown-await-token.markdownDescription: `await name;` when no `with async=name` block in the file starts that token. A hint by default: a module the file calls might start it.

too-few-arguments.markdownDescription: A function call with fewer arguments than every documented form of the function requires.

template-unexpected-close.markdownDescription: A `%>` with no matching `<%` in a text template.

template-unclosed.markdownDescription: A `<%` that is never closed in a text template.

template-missing-brace.markdownDescription: A block tag such as `<% if ... %>` missing its `{`.

template-in-expression.markdownDescription: A `<% %>` tag inside an unclosed OtterScript expression.

adaptivecard-missing-version.markdownDescription: An Adaptive Card without its required `"version"` property.

adaptivecard-unknown-type.markdownDescription: An unrecognized Adaptive Card element or action `"type"`.

adaptivecard-version-too-low.markdownDescription: An Adaptive Card element, action or property newer than the card's declared `"version"`.

adaptivecard-version-too-high.markdownDescription: An Adaptive Card `"version"` newer than `#otterscript.adaptiveCards.maxVersion#`, the highest version the target host supports.

adaptivecard-invalid-value.markdownDescription: An Adaptive Card property value that isn't one of the property's allowed values, such as `"weight": "bold"` (should be `"bolder"`).

adaptivecard-templating-keyword.markdownDescription: An Adaptive Card Templating key such as `"$data"` or `"$when"`, which OtterScript expands as a variable in a text template.

adaptivecard-unknown-target.markdownDescription: An `Action.ToggleVisibility` target that isn't the `"id"` of any element in the Adaptive Card.

adaptivecard-duplicate-id.markdownDescription: An `"id"` that another element in the same Adaptive Card already has.

adaptivecard-content-type.markdownDescription: A Teams message attachment holding an Adaptive Card without `"contentType": "application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive"`.

adaptivecard-webhook-submit.markdownDescription: `Action.Submit` in a card sent as a Teams message (incoming webhooks and Workflows don't support it).

otterscript.adaptiveCards.maxVersion.patternErrorMessage: A card version such as 1.5 or 1.6.
otterscript.adaptiveCards.maxVersion.markdownDescription: The highest Adaptive Card version the host that shows your cards supports. A card whose `"version"` is newer gets an `adaptivecard-version-too-high` warning, because the host shows the card's `fallbackText` instead. Microsoft Teams supports up to 1.6.

scripts.check:js: tsc --noEmit -p jsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/jsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/jsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint:ci && npm run check:js && npm run check:lang && npm run check:cards && npm run check:reference && npm run check:changelog && npm run check:bundle && npm test
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run lint:ci && npm run bundle
